notification_api_endpoints.GET /api/notifications: Returns list of notifications with unread_count. Supports limit and unread_only parameters.
notification_api_endpoints.POST /api/notifications/{id}/read: Marks a single notification as read. Returns 404 for non-existent notifications.
notification_api_endpoints.POST /api/notifications/read-all: Marks all user notifications as read. Returns marked_count.
notification_api_endpoints.DELETE /api/notifications/{id}: Deletes a notification. Returns 404 for non-existent notifications.

notification_frontend_component.NotificationBell: Displays bell icon with red badge showing unread count
notification_frontend_component.Dropdown: Opens on click, shows notification list with title, message, timestamp
notification_frontend_component.Mark All Read: Button visible when unread notifications exist (data-testid='mark-all-read-btn')
